the design of a fault-tolerant high performance parallel virtual file system that provides high performance and fault-tolerant data storage service for data-intensive applications on a cluster of workstations.
the design and implementation of a cost-effective, high performance, and fault-tolerant file system for cluster-based data-intensive applications.
the design and implementation of a fault tolerant and high performance parallel file system, CEFT-PVFs.

CEFT-PVFs can improve the aggregate peak read bandwidth by 100% over the original PVFS while maintaining comparable write bandwidth.
the CEFT-PVS can provide a cost-effective, high-performance, and fault-tolerant storage service in cluster environments.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CEFT-PVFs provides both a high performance and highly reliable storage system for clusters.

CEFT-PVFs is not only a cost-effective and fault-tolerant solution to the I/O performance bottleneck of data intensive applications on modern clusters, but also a reliable solution to the load balancing problem of data servers.
CEFT-PVFs can achieve a higher aggregate read performance and a better load balance among the data servers than the original PVFS.

, in a parallel virtual file system, the aggregate performance of the read operations is not necessarily limited by the aggregate performance of write operations.
